title: Fourier coefficient from basis coordinates
statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, let $f:G\to\mathbb C$, and let $\chi$ be a complex-valued character of $G$. The coordinate of $f$ at $\chi$ in the character basis equals the uniform complex inner product of $\chi$ with $f$.
